changeSet.comment: Cutover: every monitored repository waits for a new proof. The earlier cutover derived a class from the shared mirror row, which another workspace's read may have written, and later answers did not update it. The next sync proves each public GitHub repository from this workspace's own read.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE repository_to_monitor SET visibility_class = 'UNPROVEN', proof_state = 'PENDING', proof_reason = 'AWAITING_READERS', readers_synced_at = NULL

rollback.comment: Fail closed: the earlier layer reads no class, and every resource waits for a new proof.
rollback.sql: UPDATE repository_to_monitor SET visibility_class = 'UNPROVEN', proof_state = 'PENDING', proof_reason = 'AWAITING_READERS', readers_synced_at = NULL

changeSet.comment: A monitored resource stores only a class, proof state and proof reason that belong together: only a public confirmation makes it visible to the whole workspace, and only a listing of readers restricts it.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Whether a repository is public is a fact about the repository, not about one workspace. Each write that stores the shared mirror row as not public, from any path and whatever the row held before, and each removal of the row, narrows every monitor of that repository in the same transaction: a public proof falls back to waiting, and every monitor's generation moves on, so a public answer from a read that began earlier no longer applies. Another monitor's failure reason stays.
